name: Soyuz TM-25
about: Soyuz TM-25 (1997-003A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1997 Feb 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1997 Mar 13), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
